settings.heading: Luxury shouldn't be a
settings.text: Lauviere began with a simple frustration: beautiful jewellery that turned green by summer, and “investment pieces” too precious to actually wear. So we made our own — 18k gold-plated stainless steel that survives the ocean, the gym and the school run, at prices that don't need a payment plan. Wear it hard. It can take it.
